# Display

The text a value has for a reader.

```rux
pub interface Display {
    func WriteDisplay(writer: &var TextWriter, spec: FormatSpec) -> ! FormatError;
}
```

An implementation writes into the destination it is handed and allocates no working storage of its own. A value
whose rendering genuinely requires scratch space takes an allocator through a separate, explicit conversion
instead of implementing this.

## Requirements

<h3 id="write-display"><code>WriteDisplay</code></h3>

```rux
func WriteDisplay(writer: &var TextWriter, spec: FormatSpec) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes this value's text under `spec`.
Returns whatever the writer reported, or `UnsupportedRequest` when `spec` asks for something this value does
not support, or `ValueOutOfRange` when the value cannot be represented in the form requested. An
implementation stops at the first failed write rather than continuing to a destination that has already
refused something.

| Name     | Type              | Description                    |
| -------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `writer` | `&var TextWriter` | the destination                |
| `spec`   | `FormatSpec`      | what the placeholder asked for |

**Returns**: success when the value's complete text was accepted

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Display.rux#L32)

## Related

<h3 id="write-value"><code>WriteValue</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WriteValue(writer: &var TextWriter, value: Display, spec: FormatSpec) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes `value` under `spec` through its [`Display`](/docs/api/text/display) implementation.
A named entry point for rendering one value, so a caller with a value and a writer needs no placeholder pattern
to put them together.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Text/Src/Display.rux#L57)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type              | Description                                |
| -------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `writer` | `&var TextWriter` | the destination                            |
| `value`  | `Display`         | the value to render, borrowed for the call |
| `spec`   | `FormatSpec`      | what to render it under                    |

**Returns**: whatever the value's implementation reported
